# Typer command index

<!-- Generated by scripts/reference/generate.py; do not edit. -->

Metadata navigation only. Authentication, authorization, tenant scope, side effects
and execution permissions remain in the handwritten references and code.

[Policy and examples](../CLI.md).

| Command | Help |
| --- | --- |
| python -m cli.main | Privileged operator-only administration; not a customer or end-user CLI. |
| python -m cli.main analyze | Run the analyze job handler (trigger evaluation + bot actions) directly. |
| python -m cli.main chains | Manage topic chains |
| python -m cli.main chains groups | Show duplicate normalized_label groups (read-only). |
| python -m cli.main chains merge | Merge duplicate topic chains into the oldest one. Duplicates are detected by ``normalized_label`` (lowercase, ё→е, stemmed). All rows with the same ``normalized_label`` are moved to the oldest chain in that group. |
| python -m cli.main collect | Run content collection & AI analysis manually (debug/analyst tool). |
| python -m cli.main collection | Manage task-scoped collection lanes |
| python -m cli.main collection import | Import VK communities and people from a pasted list as wall lanes. Identity resolution only: VK is read (groups.getById, users.get), content is never collected and nothing is written to VK. |
| python -m cli.main collection lanes | Plan (and optionally apply) task-scoped collection lanes for a task. |
| python -m cli.main credentials | Manage platform credentials (tenant vault) |
| python -m cli.main credentials disable | Deactivate the newest matching personal credential without deleting it. |
| python -m cli.main credentials list | List a user's personal vault credentials. Secrets are never printed. |
| python -m cli.main credentials login | Authorize an MTProto user session (code + optional 2FA) and store it. Re-running performs a fresh login and replaces the stored session parts. api_id/api_hash are taken from env when present, otherwise prompted. The session string is never echoed. |
| python -m cli.main credentials oauth | Run the full PKCE OAuth flow and store the L2 token in the personal vault. Opens the VK authorize URL; after the user consents, VK redirects to the public callback (`/api/v1/social/callback`), which exchanges the code and saves `vk/user_token` (with a refresh token) to the personal vault of the given web user (`--user`, or the workspace owner when omitted). This command waits for that write and reports the result. |
| python -m cli.main credentials test | Show where each platform's secret comes from and whether it works. |
| python -m cli.main digest | Digest operations |
| python -m cli.main digest run | Build and publish a digest directly (not idempotent). |
| python -m cli.main digest send-now | Build and publish a digest right now (manual run, not idempotent). |
| python -m cli.main learn | Extract durable facts from recent chat into memory directly. |
| python -m cli.main llm | Manage LLM providers and models |
| python -m cli.main llm model-add | Create an LLM model. |
| python -m cli.main llm model-delete | Delete an LLM model and reassign the default if needed. |
| python -m cli.main llm model-list | List models in the authenticated personal catalog. |
| python -m cli.main llm model-test | Run a local mock; paid probes require the authenticated admin surface. |
| python -m cli.main llm model-update | Update an LLM model. Only provided fields are changed. |
| python -m cli.main llm provider-list | List providers in the authenticated personal catalog. |
| python -m cli.main prune | Trim old finished jobs directly. |
| python -m cli.main reflect | Weekly memory hygiene + prompt-evolution proposals directly. |
| python -m cli.main roles | Manage roles and permissions |
| python -m cli.main roles list | List all roles with their permissions |
| python -m cli.main roles preset | Initialize least-privileged platform role defaults |
| python -m cli.main roles show | Show detailed information about a role |
| python -m cli.main roles update | Update exact permissions for the operator role. |
| python -m cli.main scenarios | Manage agent scenarios |
| python -m cli.main scenarios list | List agent scenarios for a workspace. |
| python -m cli.main scenarios output-schema | Set an explicit output_schema for a scenario (dry-run unless --apply). The stored schema is extended with the requested fields; the derived contract of the scenario stays intact. Without --apply nothing is written. |
| python -m cli.main scenarios seed-default | Seed a basic monitoring default scenario for a workspace. |
| python -m cli.main task | Operator-only task management. Requires an authenticated active platform admin context. |
| python -m cli.main task add | Add a task. |
| python -m cli.main task analyze | Run a analyze task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task collect | Run a collect task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task digest | Run a digest task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task digest-send | Send an existing report with per-part receipts; never regenerate it. |
| python -m cli.main task entitlements | Inspect current product grants and availability; consume no usage. |
| python -m cli.main task learn | Run a learn task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task list | List all tasks. |
| python -m cli.main task pause | Pause or resume one task in the required workspace. |
| python -m cli.main task plan | Preview a plan; --tenant adds a read-only workspace entitlement decision. |
| python -m cli.main task prune | Run a prune task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task reflect | Run a reflect task now. Use --task <name\|id> for an existing task, or pass direct parameters for a one-off run. |
| python -m cli.main task remove | Remove one task by name in the required workspace. |
| python -m cli.main task result | Read bounded task status and permitted analysis summaries. |
| python -m cli.main task update | Update an existing task. Only provided fields are changed. |
| python -m cli.main task vk-connections | Read connection metadata and capabilities without resolving tokens. |
